 Shafaq News- Basra 
 Iraq faces Iran on Tuesday in the closing match of the Basra
International Four Nations Tournament, with the hosts looking to finish
strongly against the current leaders. 
 Lebano n face Palestine at 4:00 p.m. at Basra International Stadium,
before Iraq and Iran meet at the same venue at 7:15 p.m. 
 The tournament is a warm-up for the four teams ahead of upcoming
international fixtures, including the 2027 AFC Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia, and
results count toward the FIFA world rankings. Palestine joined the event as a
late replacement after the Philippines pulled out. 
 Both matches will be broadcast live on Al-Iraqiya Sports.
